title: Versioned Repository with Optimistic Concurrency
instructions: The lesson's models are provided in `lot/models.py`. In `lot/versioned_repository.py` implement `VersionedRepository` (the `VersionedModel`, `StaleWriteError` and `UnknownEntityError` declarations are given). A first save (`id is None`) assigns an id, `created_at` from the injected clock and version 1; a later save raises `UnknownEntityError` for an unknown id, `StaleWriteError` when the stored version differs from the item's, otherwise bumps the version and `last_modified_at`. Store and return copies, and guard every operation with a lock.

evidence.label: A first save assigns id 1 and version 1, and unsaved edits never reach the stored copy
Ids are sequential and every successful save increments the version
created_at and last_modified_at come from the injected clock
A stale save raises StaleWriteError and leaves the stored value unchanged
Saving an id the repository never issued raises UnknownEntityError
find_by_id returns independent copies, or None for a missing id
Changing the object after saving does not change stored state
A rejected save changes neither version nor last_modified_at
Of eight threads claiming the same entity exactly one succeeds
